name: Balanced lookahead rounds, compact
description: Balanced lookahead rounds with its scratch cut down, still below 1,000 in reaction depth and below 100,000 Toffolis: 916 qubits, 97,249 Toffolis, reaction depth 905. The carries of a sum that forms a register are built in place and become the register. A dropped register is measured before the sum that fixes its phase is computed, so its qubits are free during it. Sums that only fix a phase merge some carries in place with a Toffoli, trading Toffolis for qubits. The two rows shared by a round's sums are held as one register and one carry row, and the ANDs they were made from are measured away while the rows are in use. Carry trees are Brent-Kung networks, except for a Sklansky network in the clearing step of the rewind.
